# Copilot instructions — rett-europe/demos

Demo-as-code for rettX registration demos: Playwright records the **real rettxweb app** with Auth0 and the API
mocked, texts live in YAML, and a manual workflow publishes a static site to `gh-pages`.
**Read `AGENTS.md` first**: it has the idea, the layout and how to do each common task.

## Rules to enforce (coding and review)

1. **Synthetic data only.** Flag any real or realistic personal/patient data in mocks, documents, YAML,
   screenshots or fixtures. Reuse the existing fake identities (`Lia Demo`, `RE-DEMO-0001`).
2. **Not a medical device.** Flag medical or diagnostic claims in any text.
3. **No secrets.** Flag tokens, credentials or a committed rettxweb `environment.ts`.
4. **Source only on `main`.** Flag committed `.webm`/`.mp4`, `engine/recordings/`, `_site/` or `node_modules/`.
   `gh-pages` is generated by *Publish demos*; never edit it by hand.
5. **Language parity.** Keys in `content/languages/*.yaml` must mirror `en.yaml` (`chapters` always; `story` when
   present; `mock` may be partial). Change values, not keys. New story card ids need text in every story language.
   `node engine/check.mjs` must pass.
6. **Cue ids are a contract.** Renaming or removing `cue('<id>')` in `engine/scenarios/*.mjs` must be matched in
   `content/story.yaml` (`from`/`to`) and in chapter caption keys.
7. **Real app, stable selectors.** Scenarios drive rettxweb through classes, `formcontrolname` or roles, never
   translated text. Mocked API responses mirror the real rettxapi shapes; don't invent fields.
8. **Keep it simple.** No new frameworks, bundlers or dependencies beyond `playwright` and `yaml`; plain
   HTML/CSS/JS in `engine/player/` and `engine/story-player/`. Brand assets come from
   https://rett-europe.github.io/brand/latest.
9. **Language codes** are rettxweb app codes (`cz`, `dk`, `ge`, `gr`, `se`, `ua`), not ISO codes.

## Validate

```bash
cd engine && npm install && node check.mjs
node build.mjs   # optional local build into ../_site
```
